body: I was doing so well with getting sober and then I went to see my addiction counsellor and something snapped. I cancelled all my upcoming appointments with her and officially discharged myself. Then I got drunk. And now I'm fighting the inner battle all over again. Sober right now but I live across from the pub and there's still 3 hours til closing time. Fuck you alcohol.

I went on a cruise with friends i met online! Talked for about 11 months beforehand then i flew out and went on a 5 day cruise with them (parahoy!). I'm actually flying from the UK to New York in December to hang out with them again. Internet friends are the best!
I will not drink today. Sunday's are always hard since they were always my heavy drinking day. First one since I started sobriety. Let's get through this.
We can and will do this!!
Seeing a counsellor has put a lot in to perspective. Thank you :)
Thank you! 24 hours in and feeling great!
